notes.title: Greetings Voyagers! - Summer Update 1
notes.notes:
Greetings Voyagers!

We’re excited to bring you a substantial update to Voids Adrift®, packed with new features and enhancements to make your adventures across the Void even more immersive and thrilling.

🌟 New Feature: Island Designer 🌟
We're thrilled to introduce the Island Designer, a powerful tool that lets you unleash your creativity and design your very own unique islands. Originally crafted as an in-house developer tool, we’re now sharing it with our community so you can showcase your talent. Your islands might even make it into the final game, becoming a part of the world thousands of players will explore!

Whether you envision open cities, lush jungle habitats, or secretive pirate hideouts, the Island Designer empowers you to bring your ideas to life. Dive in, experiment, and create stories perfect for others to discover!

🔧 Enhanced Object Editor 🔧
Alongside the Island Designer, we’ve rolled out an updated version of the Object Editor. This enhanced toolset offers more functionality and intuitive controls, allowing you to customize and populate your islands with even more precision and creativity.

⚡ Performance Improvements ⚡
We've heard your feedback and have made significant improvements to the game's performance. Expect a faster, more responsive experience as you traverse the realms and engage in epic battles or peaceful trading missions.

🛠️ Ongoing Bug Fixes and Future Updates 🛠️
While this update brings a lot of exciting features, we’re aware there are still a few bugs to iron out. Rest assured, none of these are major issues and our team is hard at work to address them. Additionally, we’ll be adding more objects and customization options in the coming days, so stay tuned!

🌐 New Language Settings 🌐
To make Voids Adrift even more accessible, we've added new language settings. You can now enjoy the game in a variety of languages, making it easier for our global community to immerse themselves in the adventure.

Thank you for being a part of the Voids Adrift community. We can’t wait to see the incredible islands you create and hear your feedback on the new tools and improvements.

Happy exploring!

The Voids Adrift Team

notes.title: An Important Message to Our Valued Nomads Community
notes.notes:
Hello Nomads, 

We hope this message finds you well. As many of you have probably heard, Unity Technologies announced a significant change to their licensing model, introducing a "Unity Runtime Fee." This fee is based on the number of users installing games built on their engine, among other factors. 

[b]What Does This Mean For Our Games? [/b]

Voids Adrift, Voids Adrift: Island Designer, Lone Masts and other titles we have developed are currently powered by Unity. While these changes are noteworthy and will impact the financials of our studio to a certain extent, we want to make it clear: We have no plans to cease development on any of our games. 

[b]Future Uncertainty[/b]

 The future is somewhat uncertain, as it often is in the fast-moving world of game development. While we've enjoyed a fruitful relationship with Unity, these changes are prompting us to consider other options, including potentially porting to another engine in the future. 

[b]Committed to Excellence[/b]

 Despite the evolving landscape, we remain committed to delivering the quality gameplay experiences you've come to expect from us. We're taking these changes in stride and actively exploring avenues that let us continue our passion for game development in the most efficient and sustainable way possible. 

[b]A Plea for Understanding [/b]

As we navigate these challenging waters, we hope for your understanding and continued support. Rest assured, your satisfaction is and always has been our utmost priority. Your feedback, as always, is invaluable to us as we make decisions for the future.

Thank you for being an integral part of our community. 

We'll continue to provide updates as we have more information. Stay safe and keep gaming, Nomads! 

With gratitude,

 Team ZaviiNet

notes.title: Greetings, Island Designers!
notes.notes:
We have some exciting updates to share with you for Voids Adrift - Island Designer, We've been hard at work making some significant improvements to the game, and we can't wait to share them with you!

First up, we have added the ability to add buildings, trees, and objects to your islands. This means you can create the ultimate island, complete with everything you need for an explorer. 

But that's not all! We've also added some stunning graphical updates, including depth of field, bloom, and ambient occlusion. These enhancements will make your islands look stunning in person.

We're also thrilled to announce that we've added some new volumetric clouds, including lots of different types. With these new clouds, your island will look even more breathtaking, and you'll be able to lose yourself in the stunning scenery.

And we're not done yet! We're currently working on some exciting new features, including the ability to paint and customise the look of your islands, which is currently in testing. We're also developing a spectator mode, so nomads can watch and interact with island designers in action. These features will add a whole new dimension to the game, and we can't wait to see what you create!

So, mark your calendars, Island Designers! Voids Adrift - Island Designer is set to release later this year, and we're confident that these new updates will make your island building experience even more enjoyable. With these new features, you'll be able to take your island creations to the next level and truly showcase your talents to the community.
